speech.heard: The United States spends 16.7% of its economy on health. LaROS spends 1.3%. That gives the United States the highest healthcare spending share on Earth. Compare that to India, which spends 3.3% of its economy on health. This counts healthcare goods and services consumed, excluding capital costs like buildings and machinery. Near the top, Afghanistan spends 15%, Germany spends 12.3%, and the UK spends 11.1%. At the very bottom sits Laos, spending just 1.3%. How much of your nation's economy goes to healthcare?
differences: base.en: 'laos' heard as 'lara' after 'economy on health'
